page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred; an engraved emblem (eagle with banner) in the middle; imprint below the emblem. No margin notes. Handwritten numeral at top right is not printed and is left out.

main_text.l: Quid Antitrinitarij sive SOCINIANI Hæretici qui se REMONSTRANTIVM nomine tegunt,& Orthodoxam doctrinam de Sacro-Sanctâ Trinitate simulant, moliantur circa Religionem & Remp. adeóque totam Ecclesiam Christianam, præsertim Reformatam, tàm in his Provinciis Fœderati Belgij quàm ubivis locorum.

l.i: Ad Illustriss. & Potent s. Ordines Generales Fœderati Belgij.

main_text.l: Apud FRANCISCVM HEGERVM, è Regione Academia.

page.notes: The emblem banner reads VIVIMVS EX VNO, given in the transcription as the banner's text. Printed signs: the Ad Illustriss. line is italic with a long-s form rendered as s. The year is printed in old numeral form CIↃ IOC XXXIII, here read as MDCXXXIII. Slight uncertainty over the exact letters in "Potent s." and "Professore." Handwritten marks at top right are not transcribed.
